main_measure.name: next-day short-direction return minus coin mean daily return on event bars
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: deeper-half minus shallower-half mean short excess return (split at median |forecast|)

reading: Situation = up close after at least 2 strictly lower consecutive closes inside the window (first 3 rows of a window use the recorded run loss > 0 instead); main mean is the mean over cases and its t is on per-day sums; deeper half = |forecast| strictly above the median; the plan's minimum counts (100 event bars with a next-day return, 80 distinct days) give 'not observable'.
decided_by: Inconclusive rule: the main measure confirms but the deeper-minus-shallower difference is at or below 0 with Welch t above -2.
